backup.production_rule: taken after P8 landed; rehearsal against it restored 76 tables / 82 ledger rows and passed 4/4; supabase_migrations.schema_migrations_backup_20260908 additionally holds the pre-change rows

forward_verification.name: nine_source_versions_present_under_their_names
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 9 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where (version, name) in (('20260831010000','privacy_requests_and_holds'),('20260901010000','canonical_booking_decision'),('20260905010000','payment_evidence_finance_review'),('20260905020000','payment_review_queue'),('20260905030000','booking_lifecycle'),('20260905050000','cleaning_meter_verification'),('20260905060000','inventory_forecast_purchase_review'),('20260905070000','finance_reconciliation_analytics'),('20260908000200','staff_users_service_grants'))

rollback.safe_until: always - only version labels change; no schema object is touched

steps.name: restore_the_nine_labels
steps.action: update supabase_migrations.schema_migrations s set version = b.version from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations_backup_20260908 b where b.name = s.name and s.name in the nine reconciled names; then delete the 20260909140000 ledger row

steps.name: keep_the_backup_table_until_verified
steps.action: drop supabase_migrations.schema_migrations_backup_20260908 only after the forward checks have passed in production and the next backup set has been taken

feature_flags.name: ledger_reconciliation_20260909
feature_flags.required_state: not a runtime flag - this release changes ledger metadata only; nothing user-facing exists to gate

compatibility.evidence: The migration updates version strings on nine existing ledger rows and asserts before/after counts and the full post-state inside one DO block; ON_ERROR_STOP plus the apply script's transaction make it all-or-nothing. Content equivalence of the nine rows to their source files was proved on 2026-09-09 by md5 of the stored statements. Rehearsed 2026-09-09 against cascade-supabase-20260909T145049Z: 4/4 forward checks, zero leftovers.

stop_conditions: any of the nine old versions is missing or any target version already exists under a different name - the DO block raises and nothing is committed
ledger row count changes during the migration
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
20260824045800_dispatch_w01_to_n8n must NOT be given a ledger row by this or any release (D-022, D-028)
